description: Shield mastery - absorb punishment and hold every eye on you.

nodes.name: Improved Bloodrage
nodes.description: Your Bloodrage generates 15 additional Rage.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Increases the rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 25%/50%.' DEPARTURE in mechanism - a talent cannot modify an ability's own `generates` block and rage_generation_pct is DEAD DATA (probed, zero read sites). Delivered as a grant_resource proc filtered to Bloodrage, which puts the same rage in the same place. The chance carries the rank curve because a proc's payload does not scale with points. The outgoing version reduced Bloodrage's cooldown, which is Improved Disciplines' job.

nodes.name: Shield Specialization
nodes.description: Increases your block chance by 1% per rank, and blocking generates 5 Rage.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 1%-5% and has a 20%-100% chance to generate 5 rage when a block, dodge, or parry occurs.' Built with BOTH halves - a node may carry effects AND a proc. The real 5 rage is exact. NOTE the proc chance is authored at 100 and NOT rank-scaled, because _sync_talent_procs only scales `chance` when max_points > 1 and would take 100 x 5 ranks and clamp to 100 anyway - so the rage is available from the first point, which is slightly more generous than the real 20%-per-rank curve. on_block alone is used rather than all three avoidance triggers to keep it to the shield, which is what the talent is named for.

nodes.name: Improved Thunder Clap
nodes.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Thunder Clap by 1 per rank and increases its damage by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0, built verbatim: 'Reduces the cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 1/2/4 rage points and increases the damage by 10%/20%/30% and the slowing effect by an additional 10%.' Both built halves are real; the slow component belongs to the ability. THIS TALENT IS PROTECTION-ONLY IN THE REAL GAME and was sitting in our Arms tree - it is removed from Arms in the same commit so it exists once rather than twice and stacking.

nodes.name: Last Stand
nodes.description: Increases your maximum health by 10% and reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall by 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.' DEPARTURE - there is no warrior_last_stand ability to unlock and no mechanism for temporary health that is then removed. Delivered as a permanent but much smaller health increase plus faster access to the tree's real emergency button. max_health_pct is a FRACTION read at character.py:1411 - verified live. Kept from the outgoing tree, raised from 0.08 to 0.10.

nodes.name: Incite
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Heroic Strike, Thunder Clap and Cleave by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, NEW to our tree, built verbatim: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Heroic Strike, Thunder Clap and Cleave abilities by 5%/10%/15%.' All three real abilities exist here. ability_<id>_crit is PERCENTAGE POINTS.

nodes.name: Anticipation
nodes.description: Increases your dodge chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases your Dodge chance by 1%-5%.' Built verbatim and kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Shield Mastery
nodes.description: Increases your block chance by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases your block value by 15%/30% and reduces the cooldown of your Shield Block ability by 10/20 sec.' DEPARTURE - block_value_pct is DEAD DATA (probed, zero read sites) and there is no Shield Block ability. Delivered as block CHANCE, which is a live key, rather than block value. Kept from the outgoing tree, corrected from 3 ranks to the real 2.

nodes.name: Toughness
nodes.description: Increases your armor by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases your armor value from items by 2%-10% and reduces the duration of all movement slowing effects by 30%.' The armour half is built verbatim; movement slowing does not exist. armor_pct is a FRACTION as a talent effect. Kept from the outgoing tree. NOTE check_talent_balance enforces an armor_pct ceiling of 60 across a class - this contributes 10, well clear.

nodes.name: Improved Spell Reflection
nodes.description: Reduces magic damage taken by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree: 'Reduces the chance you'll be hit by spells by 2%/4% and when the ability is used it will reflect the first spell cast against the 4 closest party members.' DEPARTURE - there is no Spell Reflection ability, no damage redirection, and no caster-side miss chance for INCOMING attacks (hit_chance_spell is a dead talent key, set once in Character.__init__). Avoiding spell damage becomes taking less of it. magic_damage_taken_pct is a FRACTION as a talent effect and NEGATIVE reduces - the opposite sign to its meaning inside a status effect.

nodes.name: Improved Disciplines
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall, Retaliation and Recklessness by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree, built verbatim across all three real abilities: 'Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall, Retaliation and Recklessness abilities by 30/60 secs.' ability_<id>_cooldown is FLAT turns. Stacks with Last Stand on Shield Wall; talented_cooldown clamps at 1 turn so it cannot reach zero.

nodes.name: Improved Disarm
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree: 'Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 10/20 sec and causes the target to take an additional 5%/10% damage while disarmed.' The cooldown half is built. The conditional-damage half needs a read of whether the target currently carries the Disarm debuff, which does not exist - nothing reads a debuff on the target.

nodes.name: Concussion Blow
nodes.description: Teaches Concussion Blow, stunning your target.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, kept - the ONLY unlock for warrior_concussion_blow, which is requires_talent.

nodes.name: Puncture
nodes.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Sunder Armor and Devastate by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree, built verbatim: 'Reduces the rage cost of your Sunder Armor and Devastate abilities by 1/2/3.' ability_<id>_cost is FLAT.

nodes.name: Gag Order
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Pummel by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree: 'Gives your Shield Bash and Heroic Throw abilities a 50%/100% chance to silence the target for 3 sec and increases the damage of your Shield Slam ability by 5%/10%.' DEPARTURE - none of the three named abilities exist here, and there is no silence or interrupt key at all. Pummel is this kit's interrupt-flavoured strike, so the damage clause lands there. This is the thinnest substitution in the tree and is marked as such.

nodes.name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
nodes.description: Increases your physical damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, built verbatim minus the weapon gate: 'Increases physical damage you deal when a one-handed melee weapon is equipped by 2%-10%.' There is no weapon-type key. Kept from the outgoing tree. physical_damage is a FRACTION.

nodes.name: Improved Defensive Stance
nodes.description: While in Defensive Stance, reduces spell damage taken by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'While in Defensive Stance all spell damage is reduced by 3%/6% and when you Block, Parry or Dodge an attack you have a 50%/100% chance to become Enraged, increasing Physical damage caused by 10%.' BUILT WITH THE REAL STANCE CONDITION. A talent's require_form is resolved against current_form OR current_stance, which is an engine change made in this same pass - before it, get_talent_effects passed current_form alone and a stance-gated talent silently did nothing for a Warrior, whose current_form is always None. The enrage-on-avoidance half is dropped to avoid a third source of the same exclusive_group Enrage and Wrecking Crew already share. spell_damage_taken_pct is a FRACTION as a talent effect and NEGATIVE reduces.

nodes.name: Vigilance
nodes.description: Increases your threat generation by 10%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'Focus your protective gaze on a group or raid target, reducing their damage taken by 3% and transfers 10% of the threat they cause to you.' DEPARTURE - A TALENT EFFECT CAN NEVER REACH AN ALLY, and there is no threat transfer or damage redirection of any kind. What survives is the part that affects the warrior: taking on more threat. The real talent requires Concussion Blow, which connected_to reproduces.

nodes.name: Vitality
nodes.description: Increases your Strength by 2% per rank, your Stamina by 3% per rank and your expertise by 2 per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, built verbatim across all three halves: 'Increases your total Strength by 2%-6%, Stamina by 3%-9% and your Expertise by 2-6.' The outgoing version was stamina_pct alone. strength_pct and stamina_pct are PERCENTAGE POINTS, read off `bonuses` at character.py:1262-1263 and divided by 100 - so the probe finds no literal read site and they are nonetheless LIVE.

nodes.name: Focused Rage
nodes.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your abilities by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'Reduces the rage cost of your offensive abilities by 1/2/3.' Authored as a percentage rather than flat because all_ability_cost_pct is the only key that covers EVERY ability at once - there is no flat all-ability cost key. MIND IT CAREFULLY: it is a FRACTION as a talent effect where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION, and it FLIPS to percentage POINTS inside a status effect. audit_talents caught that flip being got wrong elsewhere in the project.

nodes.name: Safeguard
nodes.description: Reduces all damage you take by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Reduces damage taken by the target of your Intervene ability by 15%/30% for 6 sec.' DEPARTURE - there is no Intervene ability and a talent effect can never reach an ally, so the protection applies to the warrior instead at a much smaller number, since it is now permanent rather than a 6-second window on someone else. damage_taken_pct is read RAW on both sides. The outgoing tree had Safeguard as a tier-6 node with -6% and +10% health; moved to its real row and reduced.

nodes.name: Warbringer
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Charge and Intercept by 1 turn.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Your Charge, Intercept and Intervene abilities are now usable while in combat and in any stance. In addition, your Intervene ability will remove all movement impairing effects.' DEPARTURE - nothing restricts an ability to out-of-combat or to a stance, so 'now usable' has nothing to lift; Intervene does not exist. Delivered as availability in the only sense the engine has: shorter cooldowns. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Devastate
nodes.description: Teaches Devastate, driving your weapon through weakened armor.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, kept - the ONLY unlock for warrior_devastate, which is requires_talent. Moved from tier 4 to its real row.

nodes.name: Sword and Board
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Devastate by 5% per rank, and it has a 10% chance per rank to reset your Concussion Blow.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Devastate ability by 5%/10%/15% and when your Devastate or Revenge ability deals damage it has a 10%/20%/30% chance of refreshing the cooldown of your Shield Block ability.' The crit half is verbatim. DEPARTURE on the reset target - there is no Shield Block ability, so the reset lands on Concussion Blow, the tree's other short cooldown. Revenge does not exist either, so only Devastate is in the filter. reset_cooldown is a real proc payload. The real talent requires Devastate, reproduced. The outgoing version was a cost cut plus flat block.

nodes.name: Critical Block
nodes.description: Increases your block chance by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Your successful blocks have a 20%-60% chance to block double the normal amount and increases your chance to critically hit with your Shield Slam ability by an additional 5%-15%.' DEPARTURE - there is no mechanism to double a block's value (block_bonus_reduction exists for the Shaman tank but nothing multiplies a block), and no Shield Slam ability. Delivered as block chance. The outgoing version was a proc.

nodes.name: Damage Shield
nodes.description: Blocking an attack deals damage back to your attacker.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Requires Shields. Whenever you take damage from or block a melee attack you cause damage equal to 10%/20% of your block value.' Built as the real reactive mechanic. Scaling from block value is not available to a proc payload, so damage_flat 30 is a fixed return. CRUCIAL: on an avoidance trigger such as on_block the incoming amount is ZERO, so bonus_pct or leech_pct would return nothing at all - damage_flat is one of the few payloads that works here. proc['school'] only TYPES a damage_flat payload; it is not a trigger-side filter. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Shockwave
nodes.description: Teaches Shockwave, a cone of force that stuns everything before you.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the capstone, kept - the ONLY unlock for warrior_shockwave, which is requires_talent.
